title: Stop older iPhones crashing, and add error pages that recover
hypothesis: Visitors on Safari before 16.4 can use every page; failed script loads recover instead of leaving a blank page.

baseline.note: Emulated old Safari crashed 79 of 115 sitemap pages on production (2026-10-14); crashed pages sent no analytics, so there is no measured baseline.

decision_rule: Keep unless the live smoke test or site_error data shows the error pages misfiring.

title: Show the whole keyboard focus ring on the chapter breadcrumb
hypothesis: A keyboard user who tabs to the chapter link above a page's title sees a complete focus ring, in browsers that can clip one axis alone; before, the row clipped the ring's top and bottom edges and only two vertical bars showed.

baseline.note: Seen on 2026-11-23 on the live site (build 95cb9d6) on the 11 of 20 audited pages that show the breadcrumb, such as /tools/plan, /runners, /half and the story and course pages, at 390 px and, where the breadcrumb shows, at 1366 px. No metric counts keyboard focus, so there is no measured baseline.

decision_rule: Keep unless the live smoke test fails or a capture of the focused breadcrumb at 390 px or 1366 px shows the ring clipped or drawn over the text. No scorecard metric can show this fix, so none is used to judge it; error_visit_rate@v1 and web_vitals_p75@v1 are named only as the nearest checks that nothing else broke.

title: Stop the home page's first phone screen dropping when the font arrives
hypothesis: On phones 390 to 405 px wide, the home page's first screen no longer moves down when the web font arrives: three lines are reserved for the replay's sentence, which is what it takes in its own font at those widths, so the lab layout shift on the home page at 390 px falls from 0.147 to under 0.05.

baseline.note: Lab, not field: the live smoke test's home run (390 px, 4x CPU, 1.6 Mbps / 150 ms, median of 3) reported CLS 0.147 on 2026-11-23 and on 2026-11-26; on 2026-11-26 an attribution run found one shift of 0.146 in each of 3 runs, the hero's text and the section after it moving down 15 px as the replay's sentence went from two lines to three. With fonts loaded the sentence took three lines at every width measured from 308 to 405 px (every pixel from 380) and two from 406 px, in miles and in kilometres; with the fonts blocked it takes two from 390 px. Field CLS p75 on phones was 0.0 over 2026-10-29..2026-11-25, from 12 samples, too few to show it.

decision_rule: Keep unless the live smoke test fails, its home lab CLS at 390 px is not below 0.05 after the merge, or a capture of the home page at 390 px or 1366 px shows the sentence clipped, overlapped or followed by a visible empty line. The field figure has too few samples to judge this fix (12 phone CLS samples in 28 days), so the lab run is the test; error_visit_rate@v1 is named only as the nearest check that nothing else broke.
